rationale: The stock is sitting at 4.1% of today's range, just 0.51% above the session low of $27.25, after a large gap-down of 6.28% on an earnings beat — a classic "sell the news" dynamic that has already played out most of its move. The mechanical setup lacks a clean catalyst or structure to favor either direction with conviction.
